summary: This Form 6-K filed by Largo Inc. reports results of its Annual General and Special Meeting of Shareholders held June 16, 2026. Shareholders voted to approve all matters: election of all director nominees, appointment of KPMG LLP as auditors, and approval of the amended share compensation plan. A total of 54,492,193 common shares (53.99% of outstanding) were voted. The filing is a routine disclosure of meeting results with no special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender, or restructuring. It is a standard current report on Form 6-K for a foreign private issuer.
